Position Summary

The Security Intern will work alongside Crest's Enterprise Security & Risk team to support enterprise cybersecurity operations, threat detection, vulnerability management, identity security, and security analytics activities.

This position provides hands-on experience with enterprise security platforms, security monitoring, incident response coordination, risk management, governance frameworks, and security automation. Interns will gain exposure to real-world cybersecurity operations supporting manufacturing, business, cloud, and enterprise technology environments.

This internship is designed for students interested in pursuing careers in:

  • Security Operations (SOC)
  • Cybersecurity Analysis
  • Threat Detection & Response
  • Security Engineering
  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
  • Identity & Access Management
  • Cyber Risk Management

Responsibilities

  • Analyze security alerts and investigate potential threats
  • Assist with security monitoring and threat detection activities
  • Participate in vulnerability management and remediation tracking
  • Support identity and access review processes
  • Develop dashboards and reporting using Power BI
  • Assist with cybersecurity risk assessments
  • Research emerging threats, attack techniques, and vulnerabilities
  • Support security documentation, standards, and operational procedures
  • Participate in incident response exercises and investigations
  • Assist with security automation opportunities using Power Platform and scripting

Technologies Exposure

  • Trend Micro Vision One
  • Trend Micro Apex One
  • Microsoft 365 Security
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Okta
  • Power BI
  • Power Platform
  • Active Directory
  • SIEM and Security Analytics Platforms

Preferred Qualifications

  • Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Cyber Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or related field
  • Familiarity with networking concepts
  • Basic understanding of operating systems and security principles
  • Interest in cybersecurity operations and threat analysis
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

What Students Will Learn

  • Enterprise cybersecurity operations
  • Threat detection and response
  • Security architecture concepts
  • Risk management methodologies
  • Security monitoring and analytics
  • Identity and access management
  • Enterprise security governance
